title: Effect-size lottery: is steering success mostly a property of the dataset, not the concept?

original_idea.body: Effect-size lottery: build several contrastive datasets for one concept, measure cross-dataset vector variance. Inference-only, open model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: dataset-robustness affects reproducibility of steering safety methods, but the catastrophic-risk link has a gap (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CAA extraction + variance stats with clear methodology; mentor-guided novice feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (cross-dataset variance for one concept); building several datasets adds modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly reliability/reproducibility work on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Dataset-dependence claimed by Tan et al.; a focused systematic quantification may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Builds on an existing claim but a controlled multi-dataset quantification may be open.
